title: 72 Disposal of cases by Courts : 31,33,928 cases were under trial in 1973, including the cases carried over from the previous year. Out of the total cases 0·7 per cent were either compounded or withdrawn. Trials were completed in 74 percent of the total cases. A very high percentage of pendency was noticed under customs Act (76·5 per cent). The percentage of conviction is very low under prevention of corruption Act (34·8 percent) while for all other offences it is generally above 75 per cent. The relevant statistics are presented in Table 17-18.
